## 1.0.0 (2026-11-20)

### Added

- **Nycta Dark**, the first theme in the collection. The editor, sidebar, panels,
  and integrated terminal share a near-black `#080808` background.
- A pastel syntax palette: pink keywords, green strings, blue functions, and
  lavender types, with rules for both TextMate scopes and semantic tokens.
- Matching terminal ANSI colors, Git decorations, and diff highlights so changes
  stay distinguishable against the dark background.

*introduce Nycta Dark for Visual Studio Code ([c8af7e7](https://github.com/fedetomassini/nycta-vscode/commit/c8af7e75e59e576762a3419e92c75ee6dae70add))*
